battery.name: agreement
battery.template_set: ours (D-013 fallback, unsourced; no published number is checked against it): 'The {N1} {prep} the {N2}' -> verb; 46 of 50 candidate nouns kept (regular -s plurals, both forms one token); prep in ('near', 'behind', 'beside', 'with'); verb pair in (('is', 'are'), ('has', 'have')), drawn per prompt; N2 a different noun; (prep, congruency, subject number) balanced exactly in blocks of 16; template key prep/congruency

corruption.name: number_flip
corruption.removes: the subject's grammatical number: N1 replaced by its own other-number form (dog <-> dogs)
corruption.inserts: the opposite number on the same noun; preposition, attractor and length kept, so congruent prompts become incongruent and back. c and s stay the clean labels, so the corrupt prompt favours s: expected corrupt ld near minus the clean ld, fraction removed near 2 (D-014 item 2)

effect_sign: positive = ablating the component hurt (clean minus intervened, on the clean prompt)
command: uv run python -m src.lesion.e3_sweep --item all --stage selection
